# xkbcomp uploads replayed one request at a time against Xorg (issue #171 phase 4):
# Xvfb -noreset, fresh server per run, every case on layout=gb
# server: X.Org version 21.1.24 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.24-1
# per case CASE:
#  1. record: fresh server, setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout gb, then
#     x11trace -n -m 1000000 -- xkbcomp CASE.xkb $DISPLAY. Every XKB request after
#     UseExtension is saved byte-exact as xkbcomp-requests/CASE/N-Request.bin, xkbcomp's
#     InternAtom replies as xkbcomp-requests/CASE/atoms.txt ('0xATOM NAME', in order).
#  2. replay: fresh server, same setxkbmap, then tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c -x with steps
#     atoms:atoms.txt (the actor interns the names in order and checks every atom has the
#     recorded value, so the recorded requests mean the same here), then xreq:N-Request.bin
#     for each request (sent raw by the actor after its XkbUseExtension), then total
#     (used by the check below, not listed).
#  3. check: fresh server, same setxkbmap, the probe runs xkbcomp CASE.xkb itself (run:);
#     its total delta must equal the replay's (the script fails otherwise).
# CASE.xkb = `xkbcomp -xkb` dump of that fresh gb server, edited (the diff is listed), or
# for usru the unedited dump of a fresh 'us,ru' + grp:alt_shift_toggle server.
# After each request: its result, the events on the probe's listeners, the XkbGetMap delta
# (grammar as in xorg-xkb-change-keyboard-mapping.txt) and, from -x, the delta of
# GetCompatMap / GetIndicatorMap / GetNames / GetGeometry lines ('-'/'+' + the line;
# grammar as in xorg-xkb-pristine.txt, whose layout=gb case is the state before).
# In raw event hex the sequence number (bytes 2-3) and time (4-7) differ between runs, and
# NewKeyboardNotify bytes 18-31 are uninitialised stack in Xorg (differ too). A level name
# printed '?' is one Xorg has not initialised (a type SetMap gave more levels, until SetNames
# writes its level names; see take_xsnap in the probe).
## case identity
# edit of the gb dump:
# xkbcomp requests (seq bytes decoded-request):

#   0074  2020 XKEYBOARD-Request(20): SetGeometry deviceSpec=0x100 nShapes=15 nSections=4 widthMM=4700 heightMM=1800 nProperties=1 nColors=6 nDoodads=7 nKeyAliases=2
#   non-XKB requests: QueryExtension x1, Enable x1, CreateGC x1, GetProperty x1, InternAtom x105, FreeGC x1, GetInputFocus x1
